inbound.subject: Delay in clearing INV-2026-0142 and INV-2026-0157
inbound.body_text:
Dear Team,

Owing to a delay in our own collections we will not be able to clear invoices INV-2026-0142 and INV-2026-0157 on the due dates. We will revert with a firm payment date shortly.

Regards,
Suresh Rao
Bharat Precision Tools

recorded_reply.body_text:
Dear Mr. Rao,

Thank you for letting us know about the delay. We have noted that payment for invoice INV-2026-0142 (₹2,36,000.00, due 15 Aug 2026) and invoice INV-2026-0157 (₹1,18,000.00, due 30 Aug 2026) is running later than the agreed terms. The total outstanding on your account is ₹3,54,000.00.

Please share the expected payment date and the UTR once the transfer is made, so we can update our records promptly.

Warm regards,
Accounts Receivable
Nexren AI
